cohort: The study included 240 births from 162 women with biopsy-proven MASLD, compared to 1140 matched reference births from 1138 women.
finding: MASLD is identified as a risk factor for preterm birth, independent of obesity and familial factors, but it is not associated with increased stillbirths or neonatal deaths.
mod_finding: MASLD was linked to increased odds of cesarean section, although this association was not significant when compared with overweight/obese reference women.
